config.selection_metric: mean validation negative log-likelihood across the eight fixed validation questions
config.round_two_reason: After the first five candidates, nonlinear models overfit and the training-derived pooled-scale baseline beat every model on validation NLL. Add two prior-informed regularized linear candidates; this is adaptive validation selection.
config.protocol: Two-round small comparison. Fit shared weights on 1658 training people; infer development vectors from 92 anchors only. Select on validation NLL. Final test files are never opened.

limitations: Only eight validation questions, including two policy questions; selection may overfit these questions.
Validation accuracy is not directly comparable with training accuracy on different questions.
Final test remains sealed; future-policy survey predictions remain unvalidated.
checks: five predeclared first-round candidates and two documented adaptive second-round candidates
development vectors fitted from anchors only
shared weights unchanged during anchor fitting
valid normalized probabilities and masked options
